sar.narrative: Customer C06224, holder of card C06224-K2, is the subject of this report due to suspected fraudulent activity involving transactions designed to evade thresholds. Between 2016-12-31 22:43 and 2016-12-31 23:55, three online transactions totaling $1,399.87 were executed on the card from device profile 'MacOS | Mac OS X 10_9_5 | chrome 66.0 | 2560x1600'. These transactions consisted of $499.92 on 2016-12-31 at 22:43 (transaction 3590539), $499.94 on 2016-12-31 at 23:26 (transaction 3590651), and $400.01 on 2016-12-31 at 23:55 (transaction 3590730). Every amount was kept just below a $500 authorization threshold and placed within 71 minutes of each other, indicating structuring to evade detection. When contacted by the bank, the cardholder denied making the $400.01 transaction and confirmed they still physically hold the card. This activity is suspicious because it features three online purchases within 71 minutes falling between $400 and $500, closely resembling earlier confirmed fraud cases CC-4124, CC-3841, CC-4086, and CC-3748. In response to these findings, the bank has recommended blocking and reissuing the card, created an internal case, recommended filing this report, escalated the matter to an analyst, and retained all relevant transaction, device, and investigation records.
